mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_history (tenant_id, owner_user_id, user_id, agent_id, agent_name, session_id, question, answer, trace_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{userId}, #{agentId}, #{agentName}, #{sessionId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{traceId}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, user_id, agent_id, agent_name, session_id, question, answer, trace_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, create_time, update_time FROM chat_history WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session (session_id, agent_id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, trace_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{agentId}, #{tenantId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{traceId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
